question: In a certain code language, JOHN is written as 60 and RANB is written as 72. How will YUVAAN be written in the same code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

JOHN is written as 60:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/193a64e4aad4930214994d15d6185662a3acc0738423884b47956ee66765e6ea.png] 

RANB is written as 72:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80e0febb3383d39519d47ea034b0aa83ce417067b656fb2d72a8c86969ec4198.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8555609c1ee8e4b58121b2067ea3ac769f7735af107bbbfdf1228e5ca0964fba.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "77".**
